§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Craft one Steam Cooling Hatch and one Pressure Steam Cooling Hatch. Complete this task by crafting both items. Regular steam produces distilled water at §1160:1§r, while superheated steam returns as regular steam at §11:1§r through the pressure hatch.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
The two hatches serve different recovery outlets and should be installed according to machine support and steam grade. Provide suitable storage or consumers for distilled water and ordinary steam rather than sharing an incompatible outlet. This goal records actual crafting, not possession of previously obtained hatches. Check that recovery products can leave continuously before bulk processing.
